findings.reason: The dialog div has on:keydown|stopPropagation, and handleKeydown is only on svelte:window. A keydown fired inside the dialog stops bubbling before it reaches window, so Escape does nothing while focus is in the modal.
findings.claim: Escape does not close the location dialog when focus is inside it.
findings.evidence: The dialog element uses on:keydown|stopPropagation, while handleKeydown is registered on svelte:window. After focusing the dialog or its close button, pressing Escape stops at the dialog and never reaches the close handler.

members.claim: Escape cannot close the location dialog when keyboard focus is inside it.

findings.reason: The modal sets aria-modal and tabindex=0 but never moves focus into the dialog, traps it, or restores it on close. This is an accessibility point, so it stays low.
findings.evidence: Opening the component sets localOpen but never moves focus into the dialog. The markup declares aria-modal=true and tabindex=0, but implements no focus trap, background inertness or focus restoration.

members.claim: The location dialog lacks focus management, allowing keyboard users to interact with content behind the modal.
members.evidence: Opening the component sets localOpen but never moves focus into the dialog. The markup declares aria-modal=true and tabindex=0, but implements no focus trap, background inertness or focus restoration.
